messages.plaintextBody: Sarah - the Caspian board approved the transaction this morning (Henry, Theo, Maya, Aisha present). We're clear to sign on 14 March. Can you circulate the completion checklist and confirm what we need executed on the day? Sofia

messages.subject: RE: Indigo - board approval & signing
messages.plaintextBody:
Sofia,

Great news. Completion checklist attached. On the day we'll execute: the licence (2 originals), the disclosure letter (acknowledged by Aerelon), the CL-PAT-004 deed of assignment, and the Ravensworth deed of release; plus certified board minutes from both sides. Aerelon's first £2.5m tranche follows within 10 business days. We'll handle recordal of the assignment and licence afterwards.

Sarah

—
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
